title: Algebraic closure in a finitely generated field extension is finite
statement: Let $K/k$ be a finitely generated field extension [def-pc-field-extension]. Let $k_{\mathrm{alg}}\subseteq K$ be the algebraic closure of $k$ in $K$, namely the subfield of elements of $K$ algebraic over $k$ [def-weil-relative-algebraic-closure]. Then $k_{\mathrm{alg}}/k$ is finite: $[k_{\mathrm{alg}}:k]<\infty$.
